title: Atomic Chat LiteRT-LM model list
description: Models of the `litert-lm` provider, plus where the app and `atc` find the rest. A client downloads a variant's file itself from https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/<revision>/<path> into <data>/litert-lm/models/<variant id>/, checks size and sha256, asks the core to check the file and writes model.yml last. Models of the `huggingface` organisations tagged `filter` are shown after the curated ones, with variants built from their `.litertlm` file names and offered only for the backends `huggingface.backends` allows on the host platform; a curated model with the same repo wins. A client hides a variant whose backend, NPU target or platform it does not know, and a model left with no variants, so new kinds are added next to the old ones.

orgs.description: Hugging Face organisations whose models the client lists (`author=`).

filter.description: Hugging Face model tag the listing filters on (`filter=`).

backends.description: Platform -> backends the client may offer for Hugging Face models there. Removing one closes it for every client within the hour, without a release.

models.description: Curated models, shown first in the order listed. May be empty: clients then show Hugging Face models only.

revision.description: The full commit the files are pinned to; URLs are https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/<revision>/<path>.

gated.description: The repository requires accepting its terms; the client sends the user's HF token, to Hugging Face hosts only.

context_length.description: Default context. The host never exceeds the file's own maximum.

reasoning.description: The model has a thinking mode.

id.description: Unique across the list: names the download task and the folder <data>/litert-lm/models/<id>.

npu.description: NPU generation the file is compiled for ahead of time: Lunar Lake, Panther Lake. Only on `npu` variants.

platforms.description: Removing a platform closes the variant there for every client within the hour, without a release.

min_runtime_version.description: Oldest LiteRT-LM the file loads in, when known before download. The core reads the real one from the file.

path.description: Path inside the repository; the file keeps its name inside the variant folder.
